title: Grade Letter
problem: Read a score from 0 to 100. Print A for 90 or more, B for 80 to 89, C for 70 to 79, D for 60 to 69, and F for anything below 60. For example, 85 gives B.
starter_code:
# Read a score from 0 to 100.
# Print the grade letter.

# Write your code here

hints.1: Start from the highest grade and work down: the first condition that is true decides the answer.
hints.2: Use an if/elif chain from the top grade to the bottom, with >= for each boundary, and else for the lowest grade. Because you test from the top, each grade needs only one comparison.

failure_explanation: A score exactly on a boundary belongs to the higher grade, so use >= and not >. Order matters in an if/elif chain: test the highest grade first, or a high score will be caught by a lower grade's test. Print only the single letter.
